# Finlysta - India's #1 Entry Level Financial Analyst Job Board

## Quick Stats
- **Founded:** 2026
- **Location:** India
- **Free for job seekers:** Yes, 100% free
- **Listings verified:** Manually verified daily
- **Target audience:** Finance students, freshers, graduates (0-3 years experience)

## Core Purpose
Finlysta is India's only dedicated job board for entry-level financial analyst jobs and internships. Unlike traditional portals filled with senior-level positions, we focus exclusively on fresher-friendly roles. Every listing is manually verified — no spam, no ghost jobs.

## FAQ Highlights
| Question | Answer |
|----------|--------|
| Is Finlysta free? | Yes, always free for job seekers. Companies pay to post. |
| Who can use Finlysta? | Finance students, graduates, professionals seeking entry-level roles. |
| How are listings verified? | Every listing is manually reviewed — company confirmed, role checked, links tested. |
| Will my data be shared? | No, never without consent. Data only used for job matching. |
